title: Focused low-side refinement of VALVE-173 closed->active transition in the (50,60] psi coarse-grid gap

env.determinism: EPANET's hydraulic solver is deterministic. No stochastic input is used anywhere in Phase 5; leak-node selection and leak-coefficient allocation are closed-form functions of pipe length, so no random seed is required. Recorded seed: none used.

decision_status: PROPOSED - PENDING RESEARCHER APPROVAL (unchanged by this refinement)
scope_statement: Single-bracket refinement only. Resolves the closed->active transition of VALVE-173 between 50 and 60 psi, which the STEP 6 coarse grid left unmeasured. No optimisation, no RL, no reward. Other PRVs and pumps held at nominal. STEP 6 evidence is preserved.

activity_definitions.rationale: EPANET valve status per timestep: 0 Closed, 1 Open, 2 Active. A PRV is only a control actuator while Active; the fractions are measured over all 96 h report steps.

derived.note: Practical regulating LOWER edge = first setpoint at which VALVE-173 is Active for a majority of the 96 h EPS. Below the fully-closed setpoint the valve passes no flow (0 gpm) and is not a control actuator. The regulating UPPER edge and the Active->Open saturation (observed at 100->110 psi) are already in p6_s6_active_prv_bounds.json and are NOT re-measured here. Leakage is flat while the valve is closed (the leak instrument responds to network pressure, which this nearly-inert valve barely moves) - a measured weak-actuator caveat, not used to alter any bound.
